notDiscriminating: V3 no arming step: W alone starts the motors; held 2 s it moves several metres in the facing direction
V12b the Escape key pauses and Escape resumes
V13 the game-scheme flight replays from its log to the same hash; controls: one LSB of the throttle and a 0.05 stick twitch change it
V15 the pilot profile (Mode 2) is still selectable: no mouse capture on a click, W is a throttle that does not arm, its card is the Mode 2 one

checks.id: V1 the first-run card (K opens it here): "How to fly", the mouse, W A S D, Space, Shift, F, Esc

detail.title: How to fly
detail.text: How to fly×Keyboard and mouseSpace↑Uphold to climbShift↓Downhold to descend, and to landMouselook and turn (up and down tilts the camera)WASDmove (the Up and Down arrows too)←→QEturn without a mouseFfull screenEscpause (frees the mouse)Rback to the startNnext sceneKshow this card againPress Start flying to capture the mouse. checks.id: V2 a click on the view captures the mouse (pointer lock on the canvas); before the click there is none
V2b with the mouse captured the "click to fly" pill is gone
V3 no arming step: W alone starts the motors; held 2 s it moves several metres in the facing direction
V4 released: under 0.5 m/s within 2.5 s and the height held
V5 moving the mouse right 400 px turns the aim 40 degrees (0.1 deg per pixel) and the drone follows; the camera looks along the aim
V6 the mouse up and down tilts the camera gimbal (+20 deg for 200 px up), clamped at +30 and -60, the body stays as it is
V6b the gimbal stops at +30 degrees going up
V7 Space climbs at about 5 m/s (normal) and, released, the height holds
V7b Shift descends
V8 M does not leave angle mode (the game keys command tilts); it says so

detail.note: The game keys fly in angle mode. For horizon or acro use the pilot keys (Settings, Controls).

checks.id: V9 invert-Y flips the pitch of the same movement; sensitivity 2 doubles the turn (100 px = 20 degrees)
V9b the speed setting: slow flies about 4 m/s
V10 F puts the page full screen (document.fullscreenElement set) and F again leaves it
V10b the mouse stays captured through full screen on and off
V10c a button on the top bar toggles full screen too
V11 Shift+F is the next favourite scene (its note when none is saved); plain F is not

detail.shiftF: No other favourite scene yet: star scenes in the scene list (★).

checks.id: V12 the mouse released (what Esc does) pauses into the menu; a click on the view resumes and captures the mouse again
V12b the Escape key pauses and Escape resumes
V12c Esc pauses while Shift is held (the descent)
V13 the game-scheme flight replays from its log to the same hash; controls: one LSB of the throttle and a 0.05 stick twitch change it
V14 no page errors
V15 the pilot profile (Mode 2) is still selectable: no mouse capture on a click, W is a throttle that does not arm, its card is the Mode 2 one

V16 holding Shift lands without a crash, no body sphere touches faster than half the bounce speed (the earlier landing touched at 0.72 x on this scan, this one at 0.41 x), and the motors stop by themselves
V16b the next key starts the motors again and the drone lifts off
